istem: a small log cabin bedroom deep in a snowy pine forest, a large window on the right looking at tall snow-covered pines and a frozen lake, an open stone fireplace on the left, a bed with wool blankets

a cozy city loft apartment on New Year's Eve, a tall arched window overlooking snowy old town rooftops with distant fireworks, an open brick fireplace on the left, a velvet armchair and champagne glasses

an old bookshop at night, a big shop window on the right with rain streaming down and a wet cobblestone street with glowing street lamps outside, a small cast-iron wood stove with glass door on the left, shelves full of old books
a wooden alpine chalet living room, a panoramic window showing snowy mountain peaks under a full moon, a stone fireplace on the right, sheepskin rugs and a reading chair
